The raid was busy setting a guild record and you were along for it.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: 1.7 per pull against a damage median of 3.7. The cheapest damage you're not buying.

fix.title: Broodlord
fix.text: 87% to dead in 1.8 seconds at 0:08. Worth checking what was up and who was healing you.

review.verdict: Killed by Lord Victor Nefarius before the fight

review.verdict: Average parse 96, which is what happens when the only people you're compared to are other cat druids
review.summary: The parses: 94 to 99 on every boss. The meter: 12th on Broodlord, Firemaw and Flamegor, 14th on Chromaggus, 17th on Razorgore and 19th on Nefarian, behind a hunter and a mage. 2.3 consumables per pull while the warriors next to you ran five or six. Fire Nova hit you four times on Flamegor, you were feared on Nefarian, and Nefarian's class call found you anyway. The one thing nobody can take from you tonight: you battle-rezzed Hulldor after Lord Victor Nefarius killed him before the fight, which means you were the one paying attention in that room.

good.title: Rebirth
good.text: On Hulldor, before Nefarian. Genuinely useful.

good.title: Vaelastrasz
good.text: Seventh, 1608 DPS. The one fight you were near the top of the actual meter.

fix.text: 12th to 19th on six of eight bosses. Parse 96 does not mean you were the 96th-percentile raider in the room.

fix.title: Consumables
